features.name: has_first_person_vulnerable_admission
features.definition: Does the original post contain the OP's own first-person admission of a vulnerability, such as a personal weakness, mistake, fear, insecurity or hardship?
features.spec: Read title and argument (the OP's post). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice (I/me/my/we), admits a personal vulnerability: a weakness, mistake, fear, shame, insecurity, struggle or emotional hardship that they themselves have. Return 0 if there is none, or if such content appears only as a third-party account or an attributed quotation not adopted by the OP. Ignore any OP statements that announce a view change, award a delta, or report the discussion outcome, and any post-outcome edits/updates; these are not evidence. Generic discussion of platform or delta rules is neutral. Return null if both title and argument are missing.

features.name: has_distant_third_person_observation
features.definition: Does the original post contain distant, third-person observations about others or society, rather than the OP's own personal experience?
features.spec: Read title and argument (the OP's post). Return 1 if the OP makes detached observations about other people, groups, or society in the third person (they/people/he/she/society) as support or framing, without personal involvement. Return 0 if there are none. First-person vulnerable admissions do not count as such observations, but a post may satisfy both this feature and `has_first_person_vulnerable_admission`. Ignore OP view-change/delta announcements, outcome reports and post-outcome updates; generic platform/delta-rule discussion is neutral. Return null if both title and argument are missing.

h0: Controlling for has_distant_third_person_observation, has_first_person_vulnerable_admission has no association with delta (view change).
h1: Posts with has_first_person_vulnerable_admission have higher view-change likelihood than posts with has_distant_third_person_observation.
note: Hypothesis compares two post types; the OLS cannot express the contrast beta_A - beta_B directly, so the term tests the vulnerable-admission coefficient while holding the observation feature fixed. Features are not mutually exclusive; posts with neither or both are possible. Text is current supplied text; it may contain outcome announcements or edits and has no timestamps, so timing relative to the outcome is unknown. Semantic prompts exclude such announcements. Associations only, not causal.
